spec.title: Trapping Rain Water
taskFacts: Nonnegative heights describe unit-width bars in an elevation map.
Return the number of unit squares of water that remain above the bars after rain, with water bounded by taller bars on both sides.

examples.explanation: The middle column holds three units between equal-height walls.
One unit rests above the second bar and two above the fourth.
